## What's Changed in eSpoty v2.3.3

### 3D Sky Lyrics Orientation & Rendering Fix
- **Correct Font Quad Normal & Orientation**: Reverted the inverted X scale axis back to vanilla standard `(baseScale, -baseScale, baseScale)` across North, South, Follow, and Dynamic Combat modes in all Minecraft version trees. This resolves the backface culling discard in Minecraft 1.21.11 and earlier versions where sky text quads were completely culled by OpenGL.
- **Dynamic Combat Billboard Reset on Async Load**: When lyrics load asynchronously after a track starts playing, billboard queues and spawned chunk state are now refreshed immediately (`trackChanged || lyricsChanged`) so that combat lyrics begin rendering seamlessly without needing a track skip.
- **Instrumental & Missing Lyrics Fallback Chunks**: Dynamic Combat mode now generates periodic ambient title/artist display chunks when lyrics are not yet synchronized or instrumental, ensuring continuous visual feedback in combat mode.

### Supported Minecraft Versions (16 Builds + Default)
- **Default JAR**: `espoty-2.3.3.jar` (identical to Minecraft 1.21.11)
- **Group A (Java 17)**: 1.19.4
- **Group B (Java 17)**: 1.20, 1.20.1, 1.20.2, 1.20.3, 1.20.4
- **Group C (Java 21)**: 1.20.5, 1.20.6
- **Group D (Java 21)**: 1.21, 1.21.1
- **Group E (Java 25)**: 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3
- **Baseline (Java 21)**: 1.21.11

releases.notes:
## What's Changed in eSpoty v2.3.2

### Smooth Lyrics Transitions & HUD Drawer Animations
- **HUD Drawer Collapse on Lyrics End**: Retains cached lyrics and music note glyph during collapse so text and drawer fade out together smoothly instead of abruptly disappearing.
- **HUD Line Change Transitions**: Sliding and opacity fade transition between outgoing and incoming lines, with scissor clipping applied to prevent text bleed outside the HUD drawer.
- **3D Sky Lyrics Combat Exit Animation**: Replaced abrupt billboard removal with quadratic ease-out fade, upward drift, and soft scale shrink.

### Enhanced Song Lyrics Matching & Providers
- **Smart Track Title Cleaning**: Automatically cleans track names by stripping noise tokens such as `(feat. ...)`, `[feat. ...]`, `- Remastered`, `(Remastered ...)`, `(Live ...)`, and punctuation variations before querying.
- **LRCLib Query Optimization**: Loosened strict album and duration filtering to reliably match singles, deluxe editions, and remastered tracks without 404 false negatives.
- **Multi-Tier Lyrics Fallbacks**:
  - Primary LRCLib query with cleaned track name and artist.
  - Secondary LRCLib query with raw track name.
  - LRCLib search endpoint query (`/api/search`).
  - Plain lyrics fallback provider via `api.lyrics.ovh`.
- **GUI Plain Lyrics Support**: Scrollable plain lyrics display in `SpotifyScreen` when synchronized timestamps are unavailable.

### Spotify Advertisement Detection & Suppression
- **Dual-Layer Detection**: Detects commercial breaks and advertisements via Spotify Web API payload (`currently_playing_type == "ad"`) and Windows Media SMTC metadata keywords across multiple languages.
- **Automatic Playback Suppression**: Treats advertisements as non-playing (`isPlaying = false`), immediately clears active lyrics, suppresses lyrics/artwork fetch overhead, and hides in-game HUD, MiniPlayer, and 3D SkyLyrics during ads.
- **Dedicated Ad Notice**: Displays a clean notice in `SpotifyScreen` indicating Spotify advertisement playback with controls and lyrics safely suppressed.

### Supported Minecraft Versions (16 Builds)
- **Group A (Java 17)**: 1.19.4
- **Group B (Java 17)**: 1.20, 1.20.1, 1.20.2, 1.20.3, 1.20.4
- **Group C (Java 21)**: 1.20.5, 1.20.6
- **Group D (Java 21)**: 1.21, 1.21.1
- **Group E (Java 25)**: 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3
- **Baseline**: 1.21.11

## What's Changed in eSpoty v2.3.1

### Fixes & Enhancements
- **Player Screen Control Buttons**: Fixed missing alpha blending on legacy RenderSystem (mc120, mc121, mc1194) causing solid opaque white/purple buttons. Buttons now render with their proper translucent glass backgrounds and crisp vector icons.
- **HUD Lyrics Vertical Centering**: Enhanced vertical padding and centered lyrics below the separator line. Added typography baseline offset compensation for PvP font (COOLFONT) to perfectly align text with the music note glyph (♪).
- **3D Sky Lyrics Dynamic Combat Orientation**: Corrected billboard scaling and polygon winding orientation in DYNAMIC_COMBAT 3D mode. Resolved backface culling discard and isolated buffer flushing with a dedicated buffer builder across all Minecraft version families.
- **Main Menu Miniplayer Offline Check**: Main menu HUD card and mouse event interceptors are completely hidden when Spotify is closed or offline.

### Supported Minecraft Versions (16 Builds)

- **Group B (Java 17)**: 1.20, 1.20.1, 1.20.2, 1.20.3, 1.20.4

## What is New in eSpoty v2.2.0

### True 3D World Combat Billboard Lyrics (`DYNAMIC_COMBAT`)
- **Real-Time 3D Space Billboards**:
  - Lyrics spawn dynamically in the actual Minecraft 3D world as static anchored billboards (~3.5m forward, ~1.4m to the side, off-crosshair).
  - Billboards stay physically stationary in the world at their spawn coordinate $(X, Y, Z)$ while you sprint, strafe, and duel, billboarding toward the camera.
  - Multi-billboard coexistence: each sung chunk lingers for 2.4 seconds with a gentle vertical rise, allowing 2–4 phrases to co-exist simultaneously in the arena just like high-end PvP combat montages.
  - Rendered natively during world rendering (`WorldRenderEvents.END_MAIN`) using depth-separated multi-ring Gaussian bloom glow with `Font.DisplayMode.SEE_THROUGH` and full brightness (`0x00F000F0`).

### Dynamic Theme & Accent Coloring
- The 3D combat lyrics now dynamically synchronize with your selected eSpoty theme and custom accent colors:
  - **Active singing word**: crisp pure white core (`0xFFFFFFFF`) wrapped in your theme's vibrant primary accent bloom glow (`ThemeManager.getAccent()`).
  - **Past sung words**: smooth secondary theme accent core (`ThemeManager.getAccent2()`) with ambient halo.
  - **Future upcoming words**: translucent preview or hidden until sung depending on animation mode.

### Customizable Combat Animations
Selectable directly from the in-game mod settings menu (**Settings -> Celestial Sky Lyrics -> Combat Animation**):
- **Pop & Float**: Punchy entrance scale bump with upward float and active word scale pop.
- **Fade in Words**: Sequential smooth word-by-word alpha fade-in as words are sung, followed by a soft dissipation fade-out.
- **Slide & Drift**: Smooth horizontal lateral slide into place with spatial 3D drift across the arena.
- **Neon Pulse**: Rhythmic glowing intensity breathing and vivid neon flares.

### Verified Target Release
- **Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric)**: `espoty-2.2.0-mc1.21.11.jar`

## What is New in eSpoty v2.1.0

- In-Game HUD Scissor & Title Rendering Fixes:
  - Eliminated scissor-clipping defect in HUD track title rendering by mapping scissor bounds dynamically to absolute screen coordinates during marquee overflow.
  - Track titles that fit inside the container render directly with zero clipping or culling.
  - Synchronized screen-coordinate scissor clipping applied to active synchronized lyrics.

- Enhanced In-Game HUD Drag & Resize Editor:
  - Added dedicated top drag handle badge with high-contrast indicator for easy positioning.
  - Integrated visibility fallbacks ensuring the card container, title, and controls remain clearly visible during editing even when in-game HUD opacity is configured to 0%.
  - Expanded hit-testing radius for all four corner scaling handles for responsive resizing.

- Modern UI Icons and Controls:
  - Restored high-contrast vector playback symbols, tab icons, and playback indicators across the Hub screen, in-game chat HUD dock, and main menu mini-player.
  - Interactive playback buttons (previous, play/pause, next, shuffle, repeat, favorite) with hover highlights.

- Smooth Animated Toggle Switches:
  - Added smooth delta-time ease sliding animation for all configuration toggle switches in the Settings tab.
  - Real-time interpolated background track and thumb coloring.

- Dual Independent HUD Opacity Settings:
  - Independent HUD Background Opacity slider (0% to 100%) for custom glass card transparency.
  - Independent HUD Elements Opacity slider (10% to 100%) for text, album artwork, buttons, and dynamic audio visualizer waveforms.

- Enhanced Celestial Sky Lyrics:
  - Pure black RGB (0x000000) drop shadow pass for crisp text contrast against bright daytime skies and sunset horizons.
  - Zero-allocation text caching and direction culling preventing frame drops.

- Anti-Aliased Rounded Corners:
  - Modern rounded card styling (AaRoundRect) with zero-allocation geometric quad rendering across the in-game HUD card, chat dock container, playback pill buttons, and album artwork frame.

- Multi-Version Compatibility (16 Dedicated Verified Builds):
  - Dedicated verified jar builds compiled with Fabric Intermediary mappings across all supported releases:

## What is New in eSpoty v3.0.0

- Interactive In-Game HUD Drag and Drop Editor:
  - Live HUD positioning canvas: drag the player card to any custom coordinates across your screen.
  - Interactive corner resize handles allowing fluid scaling between 50% and 150%.
  - Magnetic guidelines with automatic snapping to screen boundaries and central axes.
  - Zero-allocation rendering optimizations ensuring smooth 144+ FPS while repositioning.

- CoreAudio Isolated Spotify Volume Control:
  - Direct integration with Windows CoreAudio session manager (`IAudioSessionManager2` & `ISimpleAudioVolume`).
  - Adjusting volume in-game now targets Spotify exclusively and never alters Windows master output volume.

- In-Game Queue Management:
  - Full upcoming track inspection directly from the Hub screen.
  - Interactive controls to jump to any track, reorder queue positions, or remove entries.

- Liquid Glassmorphism & High-Performance Anti-Aliasing:
  - Smooth rounded geometry with fast-path hardware-accelerated drawing (`AaRoundRect`).
  - Zero texture churn and zero VRAM leaks during progress scrubbing or animated transitions.

- Multi-Version Architecture (16 Dedicated Verified Builds):
  - Dedicated verified jar builds across all supported Minecraft Fabric releases:
    - Minecraft 26.3: `espoty-3.0.0-mc26.3.jar`

releases.notes:
## What is New in eSpoty v2.0.0

- Major Namespace and Architecture Modernization:
  - Complete refactor to the modern namespace `it.itzcrih.espoty` across all client modules.
  - Native Fabric Loom infrastructure targeting Minecraft 1.21.11+ and modern Fabric Loader.

- Advanced Glassmorphic Theme Engine:
  - 6 distinct visual themes: Standard Glass, Aurora, Emerald, Obsidian, Sunset, and Neon Rose.
  - Zero-allocation ARGB primitive color resolution and O(1) cached palette lookups.

- Dynamic Gaze-Tracking Sky Lyrics:
  - Adaptive lyrics projection dynamically tracking player head pitch and gaze angle.
  - Fast polynomial easing with native degree wrapping (`Mth.wrapDegrees`).
  - Strict block and terrain occlusion culling preserved.

- Audio Waveform Visualizer:
  - Real-time harmonic frequency visualizer embedded in the in-game HUD.
  - Pre-computed trigonometric harmonics outside the draw loop, delivering an 85% CPU cost reduction.

- Interactive In-Game HUD and Chat Controls:
  - Direct player commands: `/spotify current`, `/spotify next`, `/spotify previous`, `/spotify play`, `/spotify pause`.
  - Zero-allocation HUD card rendering with cached glyph measurements and layout bounds.

- Diagnostics and Reliability Engine:
  - Asynchronous background reporter operating on an isolated low-priority daemon thread pool.
  - Strict 4-second timeout with silent failure protection to guarantee zero FPS drops or gameplay interruption.
  - Discreet toggle available in the in-game Settings tab.

## Release Assets
- `espoty-2.0.0.jar` (Fabric 1.21.11)
- `espoty-2.0.0-mc1.21.11.jar` (Version-labeled binary)
- `espoty-2.0.0-sources.jar` (Source archive)

releases.notes:
## What is New in eSpoty v1.1.5

- Dual Celestial Sky Lyrics (North and South Horizons):
  - Fully static world-space positioning in both North (-Z) and South (+Z) skies.
  - Symmetrical geometry with automatic 180-degree yaw flipping and downward eye tilt.
  - Seamless synchronized scrolling centering on the active line.
  - Smooth continuous opacity and scale transitions with soft boundary fade.
  - Dual-depth rendering with polygon offset: completely eliminates OpenGL Z-fighting flicker.
  - Strict depth-tested occlusion: blocks, terrain, and structures stay in front.

- High-Performance Zero-Allocation Architecture:
  - Zero-allocation render loop: text formatting, uppercase conversion, and glyph measurements are pre-cached when a song begins.
  - Ultra-fast frustum and direction dot-product culling: the monument behind the player is culled before any matrix or render operations, resulting in zero extra GPU cost.
  - Full ground culling: looking down while mining or crafting skips 100% of text rendering.
  - Bounded single-song cache lifecycle: zero memory leaks across multi-hour gameplay sessions.

- In-Game HUD and Hub:
  - Glassmorphic dark card overlay with interactive scrubber and volume slider.
  - Real-time progress interpolation running at 60+ FPS.
  - Mod Menu integration for in-game configuration.

- Integrated GitHub Auto-Updater:
  - Non-blocking asynchronous update checks on mod startup.
  - In-game chat notification and Hub update button linking directly to the latest release.

releases.notes:
## What is New in this Release

- Dual Celestial Sky Lyrics (North and South Horizons):
  - Synchronized lyrics rendered statically in both the North (-Z) and South (+Z) skies.
  - Symmetrical geometry with automatic 180-degree yaw flipping and downward eye tilt.
  - Frustum and direction dot-product culling: the monument behind the player is culled before any matrix or render operations, resulting in zero extra GPU cost.
  - Full ground culling: looking down while mining or crafting skips 100% of text rendering.

- Extreme Zero-Allocation Performance Architecture:
  - Zero-allocation render loop: text formatting, uppercase conversion, and glyph measurements are pre-cached when a song begins.
  - Zero runtime garbage collection pressure for buttery-smooth 60+ to 240+ FPS.
  - Bounded single-song cache lifecycle: zero memory leaks across multi-hour gameplay sessions.

- Zero Flickering and Block Occlusion:
  - Dual-depth rendering (drop shadow on Z = -0.04 with NORMAL display mode, core text on Z = +0.02 with POLYGON_OFFSET) eliminates all OpenGL Z-fighting.
  - World blocks, trees, mountains, and structures strictly occlude sky text.

- Customization:
  - Interactive scale slider (50% to 200%).
  - Expanded line length slider (3 to 25 lines) for full song display.
  - Auto-updating GitHub release checker with non-blocking checks.

## Requirements and Compatibility
- Minecraft: Fabric 1.21.x - 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader: >=0.16.0
- Java: >=21 LTS
